priv_lede: This notice covers this site and the Applied AI, Simplified guide at /applied-ai-simplified/. Both are personal, non-commercial projects that help people understand applied AI. Last updated 12 November 2026.
priv_short:
In short

  • No ads, no selling or sharing of data, no tracking across other sites.
  • Google Analytics runs only if you say yes. Before that, nothing is sent to Google. You can change your answer at any time with Analytics choice at the bottom of every page.
  • The Fit check, the Role check and the corner agent run in your browser. What you paste is never sent anywhere.
  • If you write to me or propose a call, I use your details only to answer you.
priv_who:
Who is responsible

Vahid Faraji, Istanbul, Türkiye, is responsible for the personal data described here (the “controller” under the GDPR, the “veri sorumlusu” under Türkiye’s KVKK, Law No. 6698). Contact: vfaraji89@gmail.com.
priv_host:
Hosting

Both sites are static pages served by GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., USA). Like any web server, GitHub receives your IP address and browser details when you open a page and may keep them in its logs for security. I have no access to those logs. See GitHub’s privacy statement.
priv_ga:
Analytics

With your consent, Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Ltd. and Google LLC) counts visits and a few actions, such as opening the CV, proposing a call or following a link to GitHub, so I can see which pages help people.

  • Only after a yes. The Google Analytics script is not loaded until you choose “Sure”. If you choose “No”, or say nothing, Google receives nothing from these pages.
  • Kept lean. Advertising storage and ad personalisation are always off. Before an event is sent, email addresses and phone numbers are removed, values are cut to 100 characters, and text you type or paste is never sent: only counts and scores.
  • Cookies. Google sets _ga and _ga_<id>, which last up to two years. Google Analytics keeps event data for at most 14 months.
  • Legal basis. Your consent (GDPR Art. 6(1)(a); KVKK Art. 5(1), explicit consent). You can withdraw it at any time; a “No” also deletes the cookies already set.
  • Transfer. Google may process the data in the USA. Google LLC is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. See Google’s privacy policy.

Change my analytics choice
priv_local:
Stored in your browser

A few settings are kept in your browser’s storage so the site remembers what you chose. They never leave your device and are not cookies:

  • vf-lang: your language.
  • vf-consent: your analytics answer.
  • vf-recruiter, vf-sound: the recruiter view and sound switches.
  • pop-fit (for this visit only): whether the Fit check hint was shown.

You can delete them at any time in your browser’s site settings.
priv_tools:
Tools that run in your browser

The Fit check (paste a job description), the Role check on the guide (paste your CV) and the corner agent (ask a question) all work inside your browser, with code and data that come with the page. What you paste or type is not sent to me, to Google or to anyone else, and it is gone when you close the page. If you allowed analytics, only numbers are counted, such as how many requirements were found and the score.
priv_contact:
When you contact me

  • Suggest a time. The booking form sends your name, email, the date and time you propose, your time zone and an optional topic to my Google account (through a Google Apps Script) so I can reply.
  • Calendar link, email, LinkedIn. Google Calendar’s booking page, email and LinkedIn are run by those companies, under their own privacy terms. I receive what you choose to send.

Why: to answer you and arrange a conversation. Legal basis: your request and the steps before a possible collaboration, and my legitimate interest in replying (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) and (f); KVKK Art. 5(2)(c) and (f)). How long: I delete booking requests and our correspondence within 12 months of our last exchange, unless we work together or the law requires me to keep them longer.
priv_market:
The job market tracker

The guide’s market pages count what applied AI job postings ask for. Once a day a script reads public postings from company career boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday) and public listings (Remotive, Arbeitnow and the Hacker News “Who is hiring?” thread).

  • For each posting it keeps only a scrambled (hashed) id, the job title in a normalised form, the role family, the level, the skills and tools it names, whether it is remote, and the dates it was first and last seen.
  • It keeps no names of people, no company names, no links and no posting text. The text is read only while the script runs, to classify the posting, and is then discarded.
  • Results are published only as totals and shares. Hacker News posts are written by people; nothing that identifies them is kept.

Legal basis: my legitimate interest in publishing educational statistics about the job market (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f); KVKK Art. 5(2)(f)).
priv_tools_map:
The tool map and weekly discovery

The guide lists software tools from public sources: official websites, GitHub and Hacker News. A weekly script looks for new tools and refreshes GitHub star counts. Public repository details (name, owner, link, stars, dates) can name a person when a repository belongs to an individual developer. Only public facts about the software are kept. If you want a tool or your name removed, write to vfaraji89@gmail.com and it will be. Legal basis: legitimate interest in an accurate, educational map of the field.
priv_share:
Who else receives data

Only the services named above: Google (analytics with your consent, the booking form and the calendar page), GitHub (hosting) and LinkedIn (if you open it). I do not sell, rent or share personal data with anyone else, and nothing here is used for advertising or for decisions about you.
priv_rights:
Your rights

You can ask to see the personal data I hold about you, to correct it, to delete it, to restrict or object to its use, and to receive it in a portable form. You can withdraw consent at any time; this does not affect what happened before. Under KVKK Article 11 you can also ask whether your data is processed, for what purpose, and to whom it was passed. Write to vfaraji89@gmail.com; I answer within 30 days. You can also complain to a supervisory authority: in the EU, the data protection authority where you live; in Türkiye, the Personal Data Protection Authority (KVKK).
priv_kids:
Children

These sites are not aimed at children under 16, and I do not knowingly collect their data.
priv_changes:
Changes

If this notice changes, the date at the top changes too, and significant changes are noted here.
terms_h1: Terms, and what this is not.
terms_lede: These sites exist to make people aware of applied AI: what the work is, what the market asks for and which tools exist. They are personal, independent and non-commercial. By using them you accept these terms. Last updated 12 November 2026.
terms_indep:
Independent, not sponsored

Neither site is affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any company, product, employer or job board it names. No company pays to be listed, placed or described, and there are no affiliate links. Being on the tool map is not a recommendation, and being left off it is not a judgement. The portfolio describes my own work, including work done for my employer; it speaks for me, not for any employer.
terms_rank:
How tools are chosen and ranked

A tool is listed when it is used in production or clearly emerging, and when what is said about it can be checked in public sources. Star counts and the Popular, Trending and New badges are calculated every week from GitHub’s public numbers and the tool’s launch date. An Emerging tag always comes with a dated reason and a source. Nothing about order or badges can be bought.
terms_marks:
Names, logos and trademarks

All product names, logos and trademarks belong to their owners. Brand icons come from the Simple Icons collection and are shown only to identify the product they belong to; showing them does not mean the owner endorses this site, or that I endorse the product. If you own a mark and prefer it not to appear here, write to me and it will be removed.
terms_copy:
Copyright and citations

The text, data compilations, diagrams, animations and code of both sites are © Vahid Faraji, all rights reserved, unless stated otherwise. Quotes from others are short, credited and linked to their source, and are used for commentary and teaching. Figures and claims from other publications are cited where they appear. You may link to any page and quote short passages with credit and a link. If you believe something here uses your work without proper credit or permission, write to vfaraji89@gmail.com; I will correct it or take it down.
terms_market:
Job market numbers

The market pages show totals and shares from publicly listed postings on the boards the tracker reads. They describe those boards, not the whole market, and are updated weekly. No posting is republished and no company is named in the numbers.
terms_advice:
Not advice; scores are indicative

Everything here is general information for learning. It is not career, legal, financial or hiring advice. The Fit check and the Role check give rough, rule-based scores from the words in a text; they can be wrong, and they must not be the basis of a decision about a person, such as hiring, rejecting or ranking candidates.
terms_accuracy:
Accuracy

I check what I publish and date it, but tools, prices, postings and rules change quickly, and mistakes happen. The sites are provided as they are, without warranties of any kind.
terms_links:
Links to other sites

Links lead to sites I do not control. Their own terms and privacy policies apply, and a link is not an endorsement.
terms_liab:
Liability

To the extent the law allows, I am not liable for any loss that comes from using these sites or relying on their content. Nothing here limits liability that the law does not allow to be limited.
terms_use:
Fair use of the sites

Please do not copy the sites’ content or datasets wholesale, republish them as your own, or overload the sites with automated requests. Reading, sharing links and citing with credit are always welcome.
terms_contact:
Corrections, removals and contact

Spotted an error, an outdated fact, a missing credit, or something you want removed? Write to vfaraji89@gmail.com. Every message is read, and verified errors are fixed. How personal data is handled is described on the privacy page.
